errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly identifies the first x-axis label as '程度量' (degree quantity) when the image shows '程度重' (degree heavy/strong).
The machine-generated description incorrectly identifies the seventh x-axis label as '光线' (light ray) when the image shows '年龄' (age).
The machine-generated description incorrectly identifies the thirteenth x-axis label as '视觉' (vision) when the image shows '光彩' (luster/splendor).
The machine-generated description hallucinates the x-axis label '少量' (small amount). The correct label for this bar is '外观' (appearance).
The machine-generated description hallucinates the x-axis label '事态' (situation). The correct label for this bar is '负面性格' (negative personality).

The machine-generated description hallucinates the x-axis label '正面评价' (positive evaluation), which does not exist in the chart. The machine uses this label in both its list of categories and its list of data values.

The description reports a value of approximately 2 for a category it calls '负面情绪'. However, the chart does not contain any bar with a value of approximately 2 that corresponds to any '情绪' (emotion) related category. The bar for the actual '负面情绪' category has a value of approximately 11.
The description reports a value of approximately 8 for the '正面情绪' (positive emotion) category. The actual value shown in the chart for this category is approximately 9.

The description incorrectly assigns the value of ~31 to the '负面性格' (negative personality) category. In the chart, the value for '负面性格' is ~13, while the value for '正面性格' (positive personality) is ~31.
The description incorrectly assigns the value of ~3 to the '正面性格' (positive personality) category. In the chart, the value for '正面性格' is ~31, while the value for '中性评价' (neutral evaluation) is ~3.
The description incorrectly assigns the value of ~56 to the '中性评价' (neutral evaluation) category. In the chart, the value for '中性评价' is ~3, while the value for '负面评价' (negative evaluation) is ~56.
The description incorrectly assigns the value of ~11 to the '负面评价' (negative evaluation) category. In the chart, the value for '负面评价' is ~56, while the value for '负面情绪' (negative emotion) is ~11.
